_comment: Maps each encoder-mapping VARIANT to its built font. The mapping JSON at src/mappings/<variant>.json is EMITTED by scripts/generate_font.py (post make_injective) — it IS the exact mapping the font was built from, so encoder and font can never diverge. DO NOT hand-edit the mapping files. Add beta/gamma entries here when their fonts are built.
_comment_version: The `version` field below is the DICTIONARY GENERATION stamp, not the npm package version. scripts/stamp_mapping_meta.py mirrors it into each mapping's _meta.version / mappingId, so it must only move when the word pairs are rebuilt and the fonts re-emitted. The packages version independently (currently 0.3.5); see packages/core/src/index.ts. Bumping this by hand without re-running the font build would make the mappings claim a generation no shipped font matches.
